claimed_method.name: CLSS_Reg8_AllBP_IMGT_Z
claimed_method.definition: Equal-weight (1/8) arithmetic average of all 7 published FLAb Biopython ProtParam descriptors partitioned by conserved immunoglobulin landmarks into FWR1-4 scaffold (fwr_flex, neg_fwr_gravy, neg_fwr_inst), CDR1-3 paratope (neg_cdr_arom, neg_cdr_pI, neg_cdr_chg), and whole-Fv (mw), plus human IMGT V+J germline identity (germ), standardized solely against the external 432-pair human IMGT germline reference repertoire.

zero_shot_integrity.weight_vector: 1:1:1:1:1:1:1:1 (strictly 1/8 equal weights across all 7 published FLAb Biopython descriptors + IMGT germline identity)
zero_shot_integrity.standardization_reference: External Human IMGT V+J Germline Repertoire (24 IGHV x 18 IGKV/IGLV = 432 germline Fv pairs)
